experiment_lock.tested_variable: Timing of verified AED 21,000 price and current availability disclosure: treatment within 0–3 seconds; control only after 3 seconds.
locked_variables: Exact vehicle: Hyundai Elantra GT 2020, vehicle_id vehicle-elantra-gt-2020-001
Verified offer facts used: AED 21,000 cash purchase price and current availability
One common base execution from 3.1 seconds onward
Same footage source, crop, duration, edit rhythm, text style, language, audio treatment and CTA across variants except for the declared opening disclosure timing
Same CTA wording, placement, objective and click-to-WhatsApp destination
Same factual claim set and proof elements
No publication, advertising, campaign creation, budget reservation or spend under this preparation approval

bounded_variables.allowed_range: Treatment: first visible and comprehensible within 0.0–3.0 seconds; control: absent through 3.0 seconds and first visible and comprehensible at or after 3.1 seconds.
12–15 seconds for both variants, with no more than 0.2-second difference.
The same exact source shot, in-point, framing and motion must be used in both variants for the full 0.0–3.0-second opening.
Identical wording, typography, size, color, screen position and display duration when shown; only first-appearance timing may differ.
Creator may select one language appropriate to the account, but it must be identical in spoken, captioned and on-screen elements across both variants.

free_variables: Final wording for vehicle identity and verified supporting facts after 3.1 seconds
Final CTA wording within the fixed WhatsApp objective
Choice of presenter, voice-over or text-led execution, provided the same execution is used in both variants
Choice of lawful non-musical ambient audio or silence, provided it is identical across variants
Selection of exact vehicle angles after the opening, provided they show the selected car and are identical across variants
forbidden_deviations: Any claim about condition, accident or ownership history, service history, warranty, financing, discount, exact trim, rarity or specific-instance advantages
Changing the vehicle, price, availability statement, offer, CTA, destination, language or base edit between variants
Using different opening footage, motion, presenter action, audio, crop, text styling or duration between variants
Showing or stating price or availability in the control before 3.1 seconds, including captions, speech, graphics, stickers or metadata visible in-frame
Adding a second CTA, profile-visit request, follow request, phone-call request or other competing action
Decorative logo, greeting or dealership introduction before the vehicle and experiment mechanism
Implying urgency, scarcity, savings, quality or trust without verified evidence
Publishing or activating any asset before separate human launch approval

content_objective.audience_signal: UAE used-car shopper comparing available mass-market vehicles around a verified AED 21,000 cash purchase price.
content_objective.promise_or_problem: Let a ready buyer rapidly identify the exact available Hyundai Elantra GT 2020 and its verified price, then decide whether to begin a WhatsApp conversation.
content_objective.desired_viewer_action: Start the variant-attributed WhatsApp conversation about vehicle-elantra-gt-2020-001.

hook_specification.first_frame_job: Show the exact Hyundai Elantra GT immediately in the same mobile-readable vehicle shot in both variants; treatment additionally shows verified AED 21,000 price and current availability, while control contains no price or availability cue.
hook_specification.first_1s_event: A clear, immediate view of the exact vehicle begins without logo, greeting or scene-setting; only the treatment adds the identical price-and-availability overlay during this opening window.
hook_specification.first_3s_information: Treatment: exact vehicle plus verified AED 21,000 price and current availability. Control: exact vehicle identity only, with price and availability completely withheld until after 3.0 seconds.
hook_specification.viewer_question_or_tension: Treatment lets the viewer immediately decide whether this available AED 21,000 vehicle fits; control creates the narrower question of what the shown vehicle costs and whether it is available.
hook_specification.payoff_requirement: At 3.1 seconds or later, both variants must enter the identical common base and present the same verified price, availability, vehicle identity and WhatsApp path without adding unsupported claims.

structural_timeline.job: Expose the tested disclosure-timing treatment while holding the vehicle shot and all other opening variables constant.
information_required: Both variants: exact Hyundai Elantra GT 2020 is the immediate subject
Treatment only: AED 21,000 and currently available are visible and comprehensible within 0.0–3.0 seconds
Control only: no price or availability information appears in any channel through 3.0 seconds
visual_requirement: Use the same source shot, in-point, framing, motion, crop and duration in both variants
Keep the exact vehicle large and recognizable in vertical framing
Treatment overlay must use the same final wording and style later used by the control
proof_requirement: Price and availability must match bf-20260811-elantra-gt-001-v1 and be rechecked before any launch
structural_timeline.transition_job: Cut identically into the common offer-identification block at 3.1 seconds or later.
locked: Only first-appearance timing of price and availability may differ
No other visual, audio, wording, pacing or duration difference
No logo, greeting, dealer introduction or competing information

structural_timeline.job: Make the common commercial object unambiguous and deliver the delayed disclosure to the control.
visual_requirement: Same exact footage, text, voice, timing and layout in both variants
Keep the vehicle visible while price and availability are readable
proof_requirement: Use only current business facts from bf-20260811-elantra-gt-001-v1
Do not translate availability into scarcity or urgency
structural_timeline.transition_job: Move from offer identification to a compact shared factual filter without changing tone or edit rhythm.
locked: Exact same block in both variants
Price and availability wording identical across variants
No financing, discount or condition claim

structural_timeline.job: Give the viewer only verified decision-relevant facts needed before the WhatsApp ask.
information_required: Select a minimal subset from the verified facts: 147,700 km, American spec, 2.0L engine, Ajman Auto Market showroom 171
Use the identical selected subset and order in both variants
visual_requirement: Show identical exterior and/or interior views of the exact vehicle in both variants
Use readable text or voice without implying that appearance proves condition
proof_requirement: Every stated fact must remain present in bf-20260811-elantra-gt-001-v1 at final human fact review
If mileage is used, an odometer view may support it only if it clearly belongs to the selected vehicle; otherwise rely on verified business data and do not fabricate dashboard proof
structural_timeline.transition_job: End on the relevance of contacting the business about this exact car, then trigger the single WhatsApp action.
locked: Same facts, order, footage, wording and timing in both variants
No additional feature, benefit, quality, history or value claim

structural_timeline.job: Convert qualified interest into a deterministic, variant-attributed WhatsApp conversation about the exact vehicle.
information_required: One action only: begin a WhatsApp conversation about vehicle-elantra-gt-2020-001
The CTA must identify the car sufficiently for Sales attribution
visual_requirement: Use the same CTA wording, visual treatment, first appearance and duration in both variants
Keep the exact vehicle visible or unmistakably referenced
proof_requirement: Before launch approval, verify both WhatsApp paths resolve correctly and differ only in their attribution token
structural_timeline.transition_job: Close cleanly after the single WhatsApp action; do not add follow, profile, call or other asks.
locked: Same CTA objective, wording, placement and destination across variants
Functionally equivalent variant-specific tracking token is the only permitted CTA-path difference
No publication or activation during preparation

pacing.target_duration_range: 12–15 seconds, materially identical between variants and differing by no more than 0.2 seconds.
pacing.rationale: The structure needs only the controlled 3-second opening, one common offer block, a compact verified fact filter and one WhatsApp action; extending beyond this adds uncontrolled material without serving the approved lead mechanism.
fast_zones: 0.0–3.0 seconds: immediate vehicle recognition and controlled disclosure difference
6.0–10.0 seconds: concise verified fact progression with no decorative pause
slow_zones: 3.1–6.0 seconds: allow AED 21,000 and current availability to be read or understood
Final CTA: allow enough time for the WhatsApp action and vehicle reference to be understood
removable_material_rules: Remove greetings, dealership introductions, logos before relevance and decorative beauty shots that do not identify the vehicle or carry a verified fact
If the edit exceeds 15 seconds, remove optional facts from B03 rather than shortening the controlled opening, offer comprehension or CTA
Never remove or shift a locked block differently in one variant
Do not use faster cuts to compensate for extra claims; remove the claims

proof_architecture.claim_supported: The promoted object is the selected Hyundai Elantra GT 2020.
proof_architecture.proof_type: Actual selected-vehicle footage plus verified business record
proof_architecture.must_be_visible_or_stated: The exact vehicle is visibly present from the first frame and its make, model and year are stated in the common base.
proof_architecture.source_or_verification: bf-20260811-elantra-gt-001-v1; vehicle_id vehicle-elantra-gt-2020-001; final human visual match before launch
proof_architecture.failure_condition: Footage is another vehicle, the selected car cannot be reliably identified, or make/model/year no longer match the verified record.

proof_architecture.claim_supported: The verified cash purchase price is AED 21,000.
proof_architecture.must_be_visible_or_stated: AED 21,000 appears in the treatment within 0.0–3.0 seconds and in both variants identically in B02.
proof_architecture.source_or_verification: bf-20260811-elantra-gt-001-v1, human-verified price; mandatory human recheck before launch
proof_architecture.failure_condition: Price changes, cannot be reverified, is presented as finance/payment, or differs between variants.

proof_architecture.claim_supported: The vehicle is currently available for sale.
proof_architecture.must_be_visible_or_stated: Current availability appears in the treatment within 0.0–3.0 seconds and in both variants identically in B02 without scarcity language.
proof_architecture.source_or_verification: bf-20260811-elantra-gt-001-v1, inventory_status FOR_SALE; mandatory human recheck before launch
proof_architecture.failure_condition: Vehicle is sold, reserved, unavailable, or availability cannot be confirmed immediately before launch.

proof_architecture.claim_supported: Any optional factual filter used in B03 is accurate for the selected vehicle.
proof_architecture.proof_type: Verified business facts, with direct visual proof only where available and unambiguous
proof_architecture.must_be_visible_or_stated: Only a minimal chosen subset of 147,700 km, American spec, 2.0L engine and Ajman Auto Market showroom 171 may be used.
proof_architecture.failure_condition: A fact is stale, unsupported, visually attributed to the wrong vehicle, or expanded into a condition, quality, history, warranty, finance, discount, trim, rarity or advantage claim.

offer_constraints: No financing, discount, warranty, condition, history, exact-trim, rarity or advantage claim
Offer facts must be reverified by a human before any launch
offer_and_cta.offer_placement: Treatment first appears during B01 within 0.0–3.0 seconds; control first appears in B02 at or after 3.1 seconds; B02 onward is identical across variants.
offer_and_cta.cta_objective: Start a unique directly attributable WhatsApp conversation about the exact selected vehicle.
offer_and_cta.cta_destination: Click-to-WhatsApp destination used by the business Instagram account, with functionally equivalent variant-specific attribution treatment prepared but not activated.
offer_and_cta.cta_first_appearance: B04, planned at 10.0 seconds in both variants.
offer_and_cta.cta_final_appearance: Hold through the end of B04 in both variants.
offer_and_cta.cta_context_trigger: The viewer has seen the exact car, verified AED 21,000 price, current availability and the same compact factual filter before the single WhatsApp ask.
